pieces.name: Navy Paisley
pieces.desc: Gold paisley scrolls climb from the shoulder, small medallions run down the sleeve, and one long motif follows the leg.

pieces.name: Ivory Pearl Vine
pieces.desc: Champagne vines and seed pearls run down both sleeves and the full length of the leg, tone on tone.

pieces.name: Noir Bloom
pieces.desc: Gold flowers and sequin dew on black. One bloom at the shoulder, one at each cuff, and a trailing vine down the leg.

pieces.name: Mauve Heirloom
pieces.desc: A beaded neckline, embroidered cuffs and a bordered hem. The most embroidered set in the collection.

pieces.name: Blush Garden
pieces.desc: Soft pink flowers, sage leaves and tiny seed beads, centred on the chest and trailing down the sleeves and leg.
